title: Jagged Crispy Moroccan Rye Flatbread
description: A tangy and crispy Moroccan dish featuring rye bread, this flatbread is perfect for a light snack or meal. It is nut-free and can be served on a lazy-susan-spinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the rye flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add the water and olive oil to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place the flatbreads on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and sprinkle with coriander and cumin.
Bake the flatbreads for 15-20 minutes or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the flatbreads from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack.
